description: For an engineering manager, team lead or tech lead asking 'what is my next role?', 'is the engineering manager role dead?', 'should I become a director or go back to IC?', or 'how do I stay valuable on the market in the AI era?'. Picks one of three paths from ELC meetup #43: Grow up (Director/Head of, 20+ people), Go deep (Staff/Principal AI engineer) or Go product (product builder), checks the 'dead zone' (10 or fewer people led AND under 2 hands-on hours a week; the tool decides this, report its verdict rather than inferring one), runs the four 2027 checks (product, self-management, AI, beyond engineering) and returns a month-by-month 6-month plan with a proof artifact per month. Call with no arguments to get the 7 questions; ask them one at a time, then call again with all answers.

ai.description: Has their team shipped something it had never built before? yes / not_sure / no One of: yes, not_sure, no.

beyond_engineering.description: Do they know how their feature is marketed, sold and supported? yes / not_sure / no One of: yes, not_sure, no.

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

product.description: Do they know their product as well as their code? yes / not_sure / no One of: yes, not_sure, no.

self_management.description: Did they set this week's priorities themselves (yes) or did the calendar (no)? yes / not_sure / no One of: yes, not_sure, no.
